title: Claude Code's Biggest Flaw Just Got Fixed by This Free Tool #shorts  #ai #chatgpt #aitools
description:
You have been using Claude Code wrong. While Claude Code is incredibly smart, it still works like a solo developer, meaning it loses context on larger projects as you are forced to jump between terminals sequentially.

In this video, I reveal a free tool called OctoGent that fixes this exact problem. OctoGent transforms Claude Code into an entire team of developers working in parallel on your tasks.

Here is why OctoGent will 10x your coding workflow:

Parallel Agents: Instead of relying on one AI, you get an entire team where one agent builds your frontend, another builds your backend, and another handles your database—all at the exact same time.

Agent Communication: These AI agents talk to each other; when one finishes a task, it automatically updates the rest of the team.

Hands-Free Execution: When tested on a full web app, OctoGent shipped clean code across multiple folders in one shot while the user simply walked away.

Fast Setup: Setup takes literally two minutes by going to their GitHub repo, running the setup in Claude Code, and adding your agents.

If you are still running one AI agent at a time, you are working ten times harder than you need to.
